description: Fix 7 (online_test robustness), fix 8a (extraction prefers the latest brief and adds nothing unstated) and the supporting guards: resilient simulation polling in a new builder/sim_poll.py (5xx on GET /simulations/<id> retried with backoff, bounded by a consecutive-failure count and the stage budget, never the chat route, never the POST), case generation that covers date clamping and multi-product kinds whenever the spec has them (with coverage logging), extraction prompt rules, the contamination script extended with the rehearsal briefs, and scripts/offline_verify.py. Depends on FEAT-001 (engine.product_deadline) for the case generator; otherwise independent of FEAT-002..004 (online_runner/online_repair/online_cases/pipeline online stage vs hooks/compiler) but runs last because it also hosts the integration helper script that exercises everything.
steps: 5.1 Create builder/sim_poll.py per plan section 5 'Fix 7' (constants POLL_INTERVAL_S=10, BACKOFF_BASE_S=5, BACKOFF_CAP_S=30, MAX_CONSECUTIVE_POLL_FAILURES=3; SimPollError; run_simulation_resilient(freya, agent_id, name, variables, max_seconds, deadline_s, sleep, clock) falling back to freya.run_simulation when the client lacks api/AGENT_LLM; POST create like freya.run_simulation with the 'concurrent simulations' wait only while the deadline allows and never a retry on 5xx; GET poll retries only on ' -> 5xx' errors keeping the same sim id; iterations GET wrapped likewise; 4xx raises at once). Do not edit freya.py and do not import builder.pipeline.

5.1b builder/online_runner.py run_batch: the worker thread calls run_simulation_resilient with deadline_s = budget.remaining() - reserve_s so it stops by itself; SimPollError -> infra_error for the live cases (keep the HTTP code in the message). builder/online_repair.py: explicit consecutive_infra_batches counter (stop after one all-infra batch), message 'simulations are not working (...)' kept. Tests: new tests/test_sim_poll.py (504 once then success resumes the same sim id; 3 consecutive 5xx -> SimPollError; a success resets the counter; backoff sequence 5,10,20 via injected sleep; deadline exhausted; 4xx raises immediately; POST 5xx not retried; fallback path for fakes), tests/test_online_runner.py (infra case on SimPollError, thread finishes), tests/test_online_repair.py (dead batch stops the stage and leaves the workflow unchanged).

5.2 builder/online_cases.py: move the business-day/deadline checks of _date_over_limit and _multi_one_date into the carrier predicate so _pick tries other carriers; all deadline lookups via engine.product_deadline; carriers lacking an account field the spec's formula needs are skipped with a precise reason; generate_cases keeps coverage kinds when truncating (order identity_lockout, promise_full, date_over_limit, multi_one_date, amount_floor, third_party_callback, tool_failure, intents; drop intents first and append 'truncated: <kind>' to skipped); new coverage_report(spec, cases, skipped) for date_clamping (applicable when promise_rules.on_after_deadline == 'offer_deadline') and multi_product (applicable when multi_product.enabled and one_date_for_all == 'cap_each_to_own_deadline'). builder/pipeline.py stage_online_test: write 'coverage' into online_test.json; for each applicable-but-ungenerated kind ctx.trace.warn('online_test coverage: ...') and _degrade(ctx, 'online_test: no case covers <kind>: <reason>'). Tests in tests/test_online_cases.py and tests/test_pipeline_online.py.

5.3 builder/extract_prompts/system.md, sections.md (intents paragraph), coverage.md: add 'on a contradiction the LATEST document wins for every field including offers, triggers and hardship handling; the earlier rule and its triggers are dropped with a warning' and 'never add an offer, trigger phrase, transfer offer or action that no document states'. tests/test_extract.py asserts both sentences are in the loaded prompts.

5.3b Contamination extension per plan section 6: scripts/check_contamination.py DEFAULT_BRIEFS += rehearsal/brief-1.md and brief-2.md filtered by is_file() (do not read *_variant_* files); tests/test_contamination.py BANNED_TOKENS += cedar ridge, harvest day, lantern day, founders' day, digital assistant, summit bank, apex trust, river bank (verify none occurs in builder/ first); update tests/test_check_contamination.py only if the default-brief change needs it. Add tests/fixtures/spec_rehearsal.json to DEFAULT_FIXTURES only if the script then still reports 0 strict hits.

5.4 Create scripts/offline_verify.py (neutral wording only): for spec_brief_a, spec_brief_ab, spec_variant_1..3 and spec_rehearsal from tests/fixtures (explicit list, no glob/iterdir): load_spec -> compile_workflow with tools/openapi.json -> lint (0 errors required) -> selfcheck.run_selfchecks (0 failed required) -> print one line per spec (nodes, lint errors/warnings, checks, failed, gaps, degraded); optional --spec FILE to add extra specs; exit code 1 only on lint errors, failed selfchecks or a compile exception. tests/test_offline_verify.py runs main([]) in-process and asserts exit 0 and the expected gap/degraded pattern (brief_a/ab clean; variants amount_floor; rehearsal four kinds).

6.1 Integration pass: full `uv run pytest -q` (>= 679, expect >= 740), contamination script, `uv run python scripts/offline_verify.py`, the two dry CLI smokes (plan 7.5), git status hygiene (plan 7.8: only intended files, tools/ public-test-set.json freya.py untouched, no commit).
acceptance_criteria: A scripted fake api returning 504 once during polling resumes the same simulation and succeeds; three consecutive 5xx raise SimPollError within the injected backoff (5+10 s), well under the old 175 s; the POST is never retried on 5xx; the chat route is not touched anywhere.

generate_cases returns a date-clamping case and a multi-product case whenever the spec and at least one carrier allow them, truncation never drops them before intents, and every applicable-but-missing kind is logged (trace warning + DEGRADED line + online_test.json coverage).
The extraction prompts contain the latest-wins and add-nothing rules (asserted by tests).
scripts/check_contamination.py includes the rehearsal briefs by default and reports 0 strict hits; tests/test_contamination.py stays green with the extra banned tokens.
uv run python scripts/offline_verify.py exits 0 and prints the expected per-spec gap/degraded pattern; uv run pytest -q passes with >= 679 tests (expected >= 740) and 0 failures.
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_sim_poll.py tests/test_online_runner.py tests/test_online_repair.py tests/test_online_cases.py tests/test_pipeline_online.py tests/test_extract.py tests/test_contamination.py tests/test_check_contamination.py tests/test_offline_verify.py
git status --short; git diff --stat -- tools public-test-set.json freya.py  # last command must print nothing
findings: FEAT-005 done, nothing committed. Light testing per user. pytest 832 passed (was 826); contamination 0 strict hits (rehearsal briefs now scanned; spec_rehearsal fixture NOT added to DEFAULT_FIXTURES). offline_verify: brief_a/ab 'gaps=- degraded=no'; variants 1..3 'gaps=amount_floor degraded=yes'; spec_rehearsal 'gaps=amount_floor,callback_window,deadline_formula,persuasion_date degraded=yes'; all lint 0 errors, 0 failed checks, exit 0. New: builder/sim_poll.py (run_simulation_resilient; falls back to freya.run_simulation when client lacks api/AGENT_LLM, i.e. fakes), scripts/offline_verify.py, tests/test_sim_poll.py, tests/test_offline_verify.py. online_runner.run_batch uses it with deadline_s=budget.remaining()-reserve_s; online_repair MAX_INFRA_BATCHES=1 counter. online_cases: date_over_limit/multi_one_date moved checks into carrier predicate (expected date = previous business day on/before deadline), _no_carrier gives missing-formula-field reasons, case order identity,promise_full,date_over_limit,multi_one_date,amount_floor,callback,tool_failure,intents with 'truncated: <kind>' skips, coverage_report(); pipeline writes 'coverage' to online_test.json plus warn+DEGRADED. Extraction prompts (system/sections/coverage) have latest-wins and add-nothing rules. Not done (light testing): dedicated tests for online_runner SimPollError, online_repair dead batch, online_cases coverage, pipeline coverage; plan item 8 _multi_lines loop was FEAT-003/other. Not run: the two dry CLI smokes (6.1) and git-status hygiene beyond a quick check (tools/public-test-set/freya.py diff empty). Double-check live: the real freya.api module has no SIM_LLM check issue (getattr fallback used), and the multi/clamp cases' expected dates against real carriers.
